en.headline: Election Committee takes 164 more forms on second day
en.dek: Returning officers received 160 candidate forms and four designated-body forms on Thursday, taking the two-day total to 471.
body: Returning officers for the 2026 Election Committee subsector ordinary election received 160 candidate nomination forms and four designated-body nomination forms on Thursday, the government said.
Since nominations opened on Wednesday, officers have taken 465 candidate forms and six designated-body forms. The nomination period runs until 20 October.

Among the cumulative candidate forms, the agriculture and fisheries subsector accounted for 67, the labour subsector for 60, and the Heung Yee Kuk subsector for 28, the government figures showed. The labour subsector received no further candidate forms on Thursday.
One of Thursday's designated-body forms came from the legal subsector and named nine nominees, according to the government's breakdown.

zh.headline: 選委會選舉次日再收164份提名表格
zh.dek: 選舉主任星期四接獲160份候選人提名及4份指定團體提名，兩日累計471份。
body: 政府公布，2026年選舉委員會界別分組一般選舉的選舉主任星期四共接獲160份候選人提名表格，以及4份指定團體提名表格。
提名期由星期三展開，至今累計接獲465份候選人提名表格及6份指定團體提名表格。提名期將於10月20日結束。
按政府數字，候選人提名表格累計較多的界別分組包括漁農界67份、勞工界60份，以及鄉議局28份。勞工界星期四沒有再收到候選人提名表格。
政府分項顯示，星期四其中一份指定團體提名來自法律界，共提名9人。
